properties.displayName: QC - Connector Offline Security Events (via AMA or Legacy Agent)
properties.description:
Identifies when the last time a logged event has been ingested into the clients workspace from the "Windows Security
events via AMA" or "Security events via Legacy Agent" connectors. Query then checks the time the latest event was
generated against the timespan specified in the associated watchlist. If the time generated of the latest event
indicates that it was generated before the specified time, an incident will be generate to prompt an investigation
as to why the connector hasn't ingested any events recently.
